text: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies,the house of Israel, with deceit;Judah still wanders about with gods,and is faithful to holy ones. [2]
t[3] Ephraim shepherds the wind,and pursues the east wind all day long.He multiplies lies and violence:They make a covenant with Assyria,and oil is carried to Egypt.
The Lord has a dispute with Judah,and will punish Jacob [4] for his conduct,and repay him for his deeds.
In the womb he supplanted his brother, [AA]and in his vigor he contended with a divine being;
He contended with an angel and prevailed, [AB]he wept and entreated him.At Bethel he met with him,and there he spoke with him. [AC]
The Lord is the God of hosts,the Lord is his name! [AD]
You must return to your God.Maintain loyalty and justiceand always hope in your God.
A merchant who holds a false balance,he loves to extort!
Ephraim has said,"How rich I have become;I have made a fortune!" [AE]All his gain will not sufficefor the guilt of his sin.
I the Lord have been your God,since the land of Egypt; [AF]I will again have you live in tents,as on feast days.
I spoke to the prophets,I granted many visions, [AG]and through the prophets I told parables.
In Gilead is falsehood, they have come to nothing;in Gilgal they sacrifice bulls,But their altars are like heaps of stones [AH]in the furrows of the field.
Jacob fled to the land of Aram,and Israel served for a wife;for a wife he tended sheep. [AI]
But by a prophet [5] the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt,and by a prophet Israel was tended. [AJ]
Ephraim has aroused bitter anger,so his Lord shall cast his bloodguilt upon himand repay him for his scorn.
